dogecoin.text:
MemeX turning memes into millions while Worldcoin dreams of scanning your soul.  
Dogecoin barks, Elon winks, degens pump TrumpCoin to the moon.  
AI coins like AIOZ flex, but HODL or get rekt, fam.  
Web3's the future, but y'all still chasing pumps?

Dogecoin's moon trip? More like a crash landing.  
RNDR's AI hype can't save your bags from gravity.  
Regulators circling like vultures - good luck, degens!  
Layer2's cool, but memecoins still rule this circus. 🐶
